title: Input subsidies and the depletion of natural capital: Chinese distant water fishing
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: Input subsidies in natural resource sectors are widely believed to deplete the natural capital on which these sectors depend. However, estimating the causal effect of subsidies on resource extraction has been stymied by identification and data challenges. China’s fishing fleet is the world’s largest, and in 2016 the government changed its fuel subsidy policy for distant water vessels to one that increases with predetermined vessel characteristics. Regression discontinuity estimates imply a long-run elasticity of fishing hours with respect to fuel subsidies of 2.2. Consequently, reducing Chinese fuel subsidies by 50 percent could eliminate biological overfishing in several ocean regions. By demonstrating the substantial impact of fuel subsidies on fishing activity and fish stocks, the findings inform ongoing subsidy reform in China, other nations with subsidized fishing vessel fuel, and the World Trade Organization.
abstract_zh: 人们普遍认为，自然资源部门的投入补贴会耗竭这些部门所依赖的自然资本。然而，由于识别和数据方面的挑战，估计补贴对资源开采的因果效应一直受到阻碍。中国拥有世界上规模最大的渔船队，2016年，政府将远洋渔船的燃油补贴政策改为随预先设定的船舶特征而递增的方式。断点回归估计表明，燃油补贴对捕捞时长的长期弹性为2.2。因此，将中国燃油补贴削减50%，可能会消除若干海洋区域的生物过度捕捞。这些发现证明了燃油补贴对捕捞活动和鱼类资源的重大影响，为中国正在进行的补贴改革、其他对渔船燃油实行补贴的国家以及世界贸易组织提供了参考。

title: A fish cartel for Africa
Opportunities and challenges for improving fisheries management through greater transparency in vessel tracking
abstract: When fisheries managers cannot see who is fishing or where fishing occurs, their scope for management interventions is limited. This lack of transparency in spatial fishing activity is considered a key enabler of illegal fishing and overfishing and hinders managers and consumers who aim to achieve sustainable fisheries. Increasing transparency in vessel location tracking is gaining momentum as a promising way to improve management of global fisheries. However, the mechanisms through which transparency in vessel activity can improve management have not been carefully studied. This paper provides a conceptual overview of the potential for greater transparency, both in quantity of vessels tracked and availability of data, from vessel tracking to help achieve sustainable fisheries goals. We identify four pathways through which these data can improve fisheries management and the conditions that enable transparency to be an effective governance tool. We qualitatively examine the costs and benefits of alternative models of transparency, including a hypothetical, fully transparent system. We highlight how potential costs and benefits of greater transparency depend on both governance context and management goals, and identify opportunities for future research to address key information gaps.
abstract_zh: 当渔业管理者无法看清谁在捕鱼或捕鱼发生在何处时，其管理干预的空间就十分有限。空间捕捞活动缺乏透明度，被认为是非法捕捞和过度捕捞的关键促成因素，并阻碍了那些希望实现渔业可持续发展的管理者和消费者。提高船舶位置追踪的透明度，正日益成为改善全球渔业管理的一种有前景的途径。然而，船舶活动透明度改善渔业管理的机制尚未得到认真研究。本文从追踪船舶数量和数据可得性两方面，对提高透明度的潜力进行了概念性概述，以期借助船舶追踪实现渔业可持续发展目标。我们确定了这些数据改善渔业管理的四条路径，以及使透明度成为有效治理工具的条件。我们定性地考察了替代性透明度模式（包括一个假想的、完全透明的系统）的成本与收益。我们强调，提高透明度的潜在成本与收益取决于治理背景和管理目标，并指出了未来研究可以着力填补关键信息空白的机会。

Advancing multispecies fishery management in China: Lessons from international experience
abstract: China's 13th Five-Year Plan elevated the national mandate for environmental sustainability. Chinese fisheries are characterized by full retention of high diversity catch harvested using unselective gears, creating ecological risks. Therefore, China launched pilot projects in management by Total Allowable Catch (TAC) in five coastal provinces in 2017 and 2018 to build experience with output controls. Fujian province launched an important pilot in its swimming crab fishery, the first to adopt a multispecies approach. To guide Fujian and other provinces in multispecies management, a workshop in April 2018 shared international experience. The workshop considered 13 case studies spanning a wide range of underlying scientific models and types of harvest controls. Multispecies harvest controls based on simple survey- or index-based models that aggregate trends for many species are typically operationally easier for managers and fishers. However, inadequate management can cause declines of individual species, sometimes leading to adoption of species-specific models and then species-specific harvest controls. This transition often incurs economic costs through scientific and management demands, and constraints on harvest of co-occurring species. The lessons revealed by the case studies suggest multispecies TACs might be effective in the Fujian swimming crab fishery given the modest number of species with similar and productive life history traits, and the market demand for all species. Continued experimentation with different management approaches through pilot projects can enable China to maintain progress toward sustainable fisheries goals under the 14th Five-Year Plan.
abstract_zh: 中国“十三五”规划将环境可持续性提升为国家使命。中国渔业的特点是，使用非选择性渔具捕获的高度多样化的渔获物被全部留存，由此产生了生态风险。因此，中国于2017年和2018年在五个沿海省份启动了总可捕量（TAC）管理试点，以积累产出控制方面的经验。福建省在其梭子蟹渔业中启动了一项重要试点，这是首个采用多物种方法的试点。为指导福建和其他省份开展多物种管理，2018年4月举办了一次研讨会，分享国际经验。研讨会考察了13个案例研究，涵盖了广泛的基础科学模型和捕捞控制类型。基于简单调查或指数模型、汇总众多物种趋势的多物种捕捞控制，通常对管理者和渔民而言在操作上更为容易。然而，管理不足可能导致个别物种数量下降，有时会促使转向物种专属模型，进而采取物种专属的捕捞控制。这种转变往往会因科学和管理需求而产生经济成本，并对共生物种的捕获造成约束。案例研究揭示的经验表明，鉴于生活史特征相似且具有生产力的物种数量有限，以及对所有物种的市场需求，多物种总可捕量在福建梭子蟹渔业中可能是有效的。通过试点项目持续进行多种管理方法的试验，有助于中国在“十四五”规划下继续推进渔业可持续发展目标。

title: SubsidyExplorer: A decision-support tool to improve our understanding of the ecological and economic effects of reforming fisheries subsidies
abstract: The magnitude of subsidies provided to the fishing sector by governments worldwide is immense—an estimated $35.4 billion USD per year. The majority of these subsidies may be impeding efforts to sustainably manage fisheries by incentivizing overfishing and overcapacity. Recognizing the threat these subsidies pose, the World Trade Organization has set a goal of reaching an agreement that would end fisheries subsidies that contribute to overcapacity, overfishing, and illegal fishing. However, negotiations have been hampered by uncertainty around the likely effects of reforming these subsidies. Here we present a novel method for translating a bioeconomic model into an interactive online decision support tool that draws upon real-world data on fisheries subsidies and industrial fishing activity so users can directly compare the relative ambition levels of different subsidy reform options.
abstract_zh: 全球各国政府对渔业部门提供的补贴规模十分庞大，据估计每年达354亿美元。这些补贴中的大多数可能通过激励过度捕捞和产能过剩而阻碍渔业的可持续管理。鉴于这些补贴带来的威胁，世界贸易组织设定了一项目标，即达成一项协议，终止那些导致产能过剩、过度捕捞和非法捕捞的渔业补贴。然而，对这些补贴改革可能产生的效果的不确定性，阻碍了谈判的进展。在此，我们提出了一种新方法，将生物经济模型转化为一个交互式在线决策支持工具，该工具利用渔业补贴和工业捕捞活动的真实数据，使用户能够直接比较不同补贴改革方案的相对力度。

Realistic fisheries management reforms could mitigate the impacts of climate change in most countries
abstract: Although climate change is altering the productivity and distribution of marine fisheries, climate-adaptive fisheries management could mitigate many of the negative impacts on human society. We forecast global fisheries biomass, catch, and profits to 2100 under three climate scenarios (RCPs 4.5, 6.0, 8.5) and five levels of management reform to (1) determine the impact of climate change on national fisheries and (2) quantify the national-scale benefits of implementing climate-adaptive fisheries reforms. Management reforms accounting for shifting productivity and shifting distributions would yield higher catch and profits in the future relative to today for 60-65% of countries under the two least severe climate scenarios but for only 35% of countries under the most severe scenario. Furthermore, these management reforms would yield higher cumulative catch and profits than business-as-usual management for nearly all countries under the two least severe climate scenarios but would yield lower cumulative catch for 40% of countries under the most severe scenario. Fortunately, perfect fisheries management is not necessary to achieve these benefits: transboundary cooperation with 5-year intervals between adaptive interventions would result in comparable outcomes. However, the ability for realistic management reforms to offset the negative impacts of climate change is bounded by changes in underlying biological productivity. Although realistic reforms could generate higher catch and profits for 23-50% of countries experiencing reductions in productivity, the remaining countries would need to develop, expand, and reform aquaculture and other food production sectors to offset losses in capture fisheries. Still, climate-adaptive management is more profitable than business-as-usual management in all countries and we provide guidance on implementing – and achieving the benefits of – climate-adaptive fisheries reform along a gradient of scientific, management, and enforcement capacities.
abstract_zh: 尽管气候变化正在改变海洋渔业的生产力和分布，但适应气候变化的渔业管理可以减轻其对人类社会的许多负面影响。我们在三种气候情景（RCP 4.5、6.0、8.5）和五种管理改革水平下，预测了到2100年全球渔业生物量、渔获量和利润。目的在于（1）确定气候变化对各国渔业的影响，（2）量化实施适应气候变化的渔业改革所带来的国家层面收益。考虑到生产力和分布变化的管理改革，在两种较温和的气候情景下，将使60%至65%的国家在未来获得比今天更高的渔获量和利润；而在最严峻的情景下，这一比例仅为35%。此外，在两种较温和的气候情景下，这些管理改革将使几乎所有国家获得比照常管理更高的累计渔获量和利润，但在最严峻的情景下，40%的国家累计渔获量反而会更低。幸运的是，实现这些收益并不需要完美的渔业管理：每5年进行一次适应性干预的跨界合作，也能产生相当的结果。然而，现实的管理改革能否抵消气候变化的负面影响，受制于潜在生物生产力的变化。尽管现实的改革可能为23%至50%生产力下降的国家带来更高的渔获量和利润，但其余国家需要发展、扩大并改革水产养殖和其他粮食生产部门，以抵消捕捞渔业的损失。尽管如此，在所有国家，适应气候变化的管理都比照常管理更有利可图。我们还根据科学、管理和执法能力的不同层次，为实施适应气候变化的渔业改革并获取其收益提供了指导。

title: Strategically designed marine reserve networks are robust to climate change driven shifts in population connectivity
abstract: Marine reserves can be effective conservation and fishery management tools, particularly when their design accounts for spatial population connectivity. Yet climate change is expected to significantly alter larval connectivity of many marine species, questioning whether marine reserves designed today will still be effective in the future. Here we predict how alternative marine reserve designs will affect fishery yields. We apply a range of empirically-grounded scenarios for future larval dispersal to fishery models of seven species currently managed through marine reserves in the nearshore waters in Southern California, USA. We show that networks of reserves optimized for future climate conditions differ substantially from networks designed for today’s conditions. However, the benefits of redesign are modest: a set of reserves designed for current conditions commonly produces outcomes within 10% of the best redesigned network, and far outperforms haphazardly designed networks. Thus, investing in the strategic design of marine reserves networks today may pay dividends even if the networks are not modified to keep up with environmental change.
abstract_zh: 海洋保护区可以成为有效的保护和渔业管理工具，尤其是在其设计考虑了空间种群连通性的情况下。然而，气候变化预计将显著改变许多海洋物种的幼体连通性，这使得今天设计的海洋保护区在未来是否仍然有效受到质疑。在此，我们预测了不同的海洋保护区设计将如何影响渔业产量。我们将一系列基于经验的未来幼体扩散情景应用于美国南加州近岸水域中七种目前通过海洋保护区管理的物种的渔业模型。我们发现，针对未来气候条件优化的保护区网络，与针对当前条件设计的网络存在显著差异。然而，重新设计的收益有限：针对当前条件设计的一组保护区，其产出通常与最优重新设计网络相差不超过10%，且远远优于随意设计的网络。因此，即使保护区网络不随环境变化而调整，今天对海洋保护区网络进行战略性设计的投资也可能带来回报。

Expanding water markets in the western United States: Barriers and lessons from other natural resource markets
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: This article identifies key barriers to the expansion of surface water markets in the western United States and examines the lessons learned from the development of market-based management of other resources. We argue that the most salient barriers to water market development are conducting and verifying trades of environmental goods and services and the challenges associated with the political economy of defining, altering, and transferring property rights. We review the extensive economics literature on markets for fishing rights, air pollution abatement, and water quality; discuss the lessons learned from experience with these markets; and suggest specific reforms for increasing the role of markets in water resource management, including minimizing the cost of trades and implementing strategies to address political opposition.
abstract_zh: 本文指出了美国西部地表水市场扩张的关键障碍，并考察了其他自然资源市场化管理发展过程中的经验教训。我们认为，水市场发展最突出的障碍在于环境产品和服务交易的开展与核实，以及界定、变更和转让产权所涉及的政治经济学难题。我们回顾了关于捕鱼权、大气污染减排和水质市场的大量经济学文献，讨论了从这些市场中汲取的经验教训，并提出了增强市场在水资源管理中作用的具体改革建议，包括降低交易成本，以及制定应对政治反对的策略。

title: Optimal harvest responses to environmental forecasts depend on resource knowledge and how it can be used
venue: Canadian Journal of Fisheries and Aquatic Sciences
abstract: Managing natural resources under large-scale environmental fluctuations like the El Niño Southern Oscillation (ENSO) is likely to become increasingly important under climate change. Forecasts of environmental conditions are improving, but the best response to an unfavorable forecast remains unclear; many practitioners advocate reducing harvest as a more precautionary approach, while prior economic theory favors increasing harvest. Using logistic and age-structured fisheries models, we show that informational constraints — uncertain stock estimates and restrictions on harvest policies — play a central role in choosing how to respond to a forecasted shock. With perfect knowledge and no policy constraints, risk-neutral managers should increase harvest when a negative shock is forecast. However, informational constraints may drive the optimal response to a forecast of a negative shock toward or away from precaution. Precautionary forecast responses arise when informational constraints make the harvest policy insufficiently sensitive to the true resource status. In contrast, uncertainty about the stock size can lead to more aggressive forecast responses when stock dynamics are nonlinear and not all fish are susceptible to fishing.
abstract_zh: 在气候变化背景下，管理厄尔尼诺—南方涛动（ENSO）等大尺度环境波动下的自然资源将变得日益重要。环境状况预报正在改进，但对不利预报的最佳应对方式仍不明确：许多从业者主张减少捕捞作为更为审慎的做法，而以往的经济理论则倾向于增加捕捞。利用逻辑斯谛模型和年龄结构渔业模型，我们表明，信息约束（包括对种群存量的不确定估计以及对捕捞政策的限制）在决定如何应对预报冲击方面起着核心作用。在信息完全且无政策约束的情况下，风险中性的管理者在预报出现负面冲击时应当增加捕捞。然而，信息约束可能使对负面冲击预报的最优应对趋向于审慎或偏离审慎。当信息约束使捕捞政策对资源真实状况的敏感度不足时，就会出现审慎的预报应对。相反，当存量动态呈非线性且并非所有鱼类都易受捕捞时，存量规模的不确定性可能导致更为激进的预报应对。

title: Responsive harvest control rules provide inherent resilience to adverse effects of climate change and scientific uncertainty
abstract: Climate change is altering marine ecosystem and fish stock dynamics worldwide. These effects add to scientific uncertainties that compromise fisheries management. Among the strategies that can respond to climate change and scientific uncertainty, modifications to harvest control rules (HCRs) might be among the most direct and impactful. We used a bioeconomic model to compare alternative HCRs in terms of biomass, yield, and profits in response to potential effects of climate change and scientific uncertainty, specifically simulated retrospective patterns, for 14 stocks on the Northeast Shelf of the United States. Our results suggest that a responsive HCR in which fishing mortality changes with measured changes in biomass builds inherent resilience to adverse effects of both climate change and scientific uncertainty relative to an HCR in which fishing mortality is precautionary but fixed. This was despite that fact that the HCR algorithm did not account for the climate effects modelled. A fixed fishing mortality HCR was effective when climate effects were negligible or beneficial. Scientific uncertainty further reduced biomass, yield, and profits by about the same magnitude as climate change. Our results suggest that simple changes to HCRs can be a readily implementable strategy for responding to climate change and scientific uncertainty.
abstract_zh: 气候变化正在改变全球海洋生态系统和鱼类种群的动态。这些影响加剧了科学上的不确定性，从而削弱了渔业管理的效力。在应对气候变化和科学不确定性的策略中，修改捕捞控制规则（HCR）可能是最直接、影响最大的途径之一。我们运用生物经济模型，比较了美国东北大陆架14个种群在应对气候变化潜在影响和科学不确定性（特别是模拟的回溯性偏差模式）时，不同捕捞控制规则在生物量、产量和利润方面的表现。我们的结果表明，相对于捕捞死亡率虽审慎但固定的捕捞控制规则，一种响应性的捕捞控制规则（即捕捞死亡率随实测生物量变化而调整）能够形成对气候变化和科学不确定性不利影响的内在韧性。尽管该捕捞控制规则算法并未考虑所模拟的气候效应，这一结论依然成立。当气候效应可以忽略或有益时，固定捕捞死亡率的规则是有效的。科学不确定性导致的生物量、产量和利润损失，与气候变化造成的损失大致相当。我们的结果表明，对捕捞控制规则做出简单调整，就可以成为应对气候变化和科学不确定性的一种易于实施的策略。

title: Status, institutions, and prospects for global capture fisheries
venue: Annual Review of Environment and Resources
abstract: We compile global data to examine the current status, trends, threats, and opportunities in the world's wild-capture fisheries. We find that global fisheries have largely diverged—well-managed, often industrial fisheries tend to be in reasonably good health, while coastal fisheries, often from low-governance regions, tend to be in poor health. Good governance seems to play a central role, and we summarize key findings from the literature on how effective fishery management can simultaneously increase food security, livelihoods, and conservation outcomes. Other solutions, such as marine protected areas and big data, can be useful but will not, by themselves, solve the main fishery challenges. We conclude by examining notorious threats, such as climate change and lack of governance on the high seas, and find that these can be largely neutralized with good fishery management, suggesting that overall, the future of wild fisheries can be bright with effective fishery management interventions.
abstract_zh: 我们汇编了全球数据，以考察世界野生捕捞渔业的现状、趋势、威胁和机遇。我们发现，全球渔业已明显分化：管理良好、通常为工业化的渔业大多处于较为健康的状态，而沿海渔业（往往来自治理薄弱的地区）则大多处于不良状态。良好的治理似乎起着核心作用，我们总结了文献中关于有效渔业管理如何能够同时提高粮食安全、生计和保护成效的主要发现。海洋保护区和大数据等其他方案可能有所助益，但本身无法解决渔业面临的主要挑战。最后，我们考察了气候变化和公海治理缺失等突出威胁，发现这些威胁基本上可以通过良好的渔业管理加以抵消。总体而言，有效的渔业管理干预可以使野生渔业的未来前景光明。

title: A forward-looking Ricardian approach: Do land markets capitalize climate change forecasts?
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: The hedonic pricing method is one of the fundamental approaches used to estimate the economic value of attributes that affect the market price of an asset. In environmental economics, such methods are routinely used to derive the economic valuation of environmental attributes such as air pollution and water quality. For example, the Ricardian approach is based on a hedonic regression of land values on historical climate variables. Forecasts of future climate can then be employed to estimate the future costs of climate change. This extensively-applied approach contains an important implicit assumption that current land markets ignore current climate forecasts. While this assumption was defensible decades ago (when this literature first emerged), it is reasonable to hypothesize that information on climate change is so pervasive today that markets may already price in expectations of future climate change. We show how to account for this with a straightforward empirical correction (called the Forward-Looking Ricardian Approach) that can be implemented with readily available data. We apply this empirically to agricultural land markets in the United States and find evidence that these markets already are accounting for climate change forecasts. Failing to account for this would lead a researcher to understate climate change damages by 36% to 66%.
abstract_zh: 享乐定价法是估计影响资产市场价格的属性经济价值的基本方法之一。在环境经济学中，此类方法被广泛用于推导空气污染和水质等环境属性的经济价值。例如，李嘉图方法基于土地价值对历史气候变量的享乐回归。随后可以利用未来气候预测来估计气候变化的未来成本。这一被广泛应用的方法包含一个重要的隐含假设，即当前的土地市场忽略了当前的气候预测。尽管该假设在数十年前（该文献首次出现时）是站得住脚的，但有理由推测，如今气候变化信息已如此普遍，以至于市场可能已经将未来气候变化的预期计入价格。我们展示了如何通过一种简单的实证修正（称为前瞻性李嘉图方法）来考虑这一点，该修正可以利用现成的数据加以实施。我们将其应用于美国农业土地市场，发现有证据表明这些市场已经在考虑气候变化预测。若不考虑这一点，研究人员将把气候变化损害低估36%至66%。

title: A user-friendly tool to evaluate the effectiveness of no-take marine reserves
Adaptive comanagement to achieve climate-ready fisheries
Are fishery management upgrades worth the cost?
abstract: Many analyses of fishery recovery have demonstrated the potential biological and economic benefits of management reform, but few have compared these to the associated costs of management upgrades, which can be substantial. This study aims to determine if the projected economic benefits of management reform outweigh the increases in management costs required to achieve those benefits. To answer this question, we developed a database of country-level fisheries management costs and use those to estimate the country-level costs of management changes. We use this framework to compare estimates of future costs of management upgrades against their economic benefits in terms of profit. Results indicate that for most nations, including the top 25 fishing nations, management upgrades outweigh their associated costs. This result is robust to a number of alternative assumptions about costs. Results also suggest that stronger reforms such as rights-based management, although sometimes more expensive to implement, can lead to greater net economic benefits compared to alternatives.
abstract_zh: 许多对渔业恢复的分析已经证明了管理改革潜在的生物和经济效益，但很少有研究将这些效益与管理升级的相关成本进行比较，而这些成本可能十分高昂。本研究旨在判断，管理改革的预期经济效益是否超过实现这些效益所需增加的管理成本。为回答这一问题，我们建立了一个国家层面渔业管理成本数据库，并用其估计管理变革的国家层面成本。我们运用该框架，将管理升级的未来成本估计与其在利润方面的经济效益进行比较。结果表明，对大多数国家（包括排名前25位的主要捕捞国）而言，管理升级的收益超过其相关成本。该结论对关于成本的多种替代性假设都是稳健的。结果还表明，诸如权利基础管理等更强有力的改革，尽管实施成本有时更高，但与其他替代方案相比，可以带来更大的净经济效益。

title: Does climate change bolster the case for fishery reform in Asia?
abstract: I examine the estimated economic, ecological, and food security effects of future fishery management reform in Asia. Without climate change, most Asian fisheries stand to gain substantially from reforms. Optimizing fishery management could increase catch by 24% and profit by 34% over business-as-usual management. These benefits arise from fishing some stocks more conservatively and others more aggressively. Although climate change is expected to reduce carrying capacity in 55% of Asian fisheries, I find that under climate change large benefits from fishery management reform are maintained, though these benefits are heterogeneous. The case for reform remains strong for both catch and profit, though these numbers are slightly lower than in the no-climate change case. These results suggest that, to maximize economic output and food security, Asian fisheries will benefit substantially from the transition to catch shares or other economically rational fishery management institutions, despite the looming effects of climate change.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了亚洲未来渔业管理改革在经济、生态和粮食安全方面的估计效应。在没有气候变化的情况下，大多数亚洲渔业都能从改革中获得大幅收益。与照常管理相比，优化渔业管理可使渔获量增加24%，利润增加34%。这些收益来自对某些种群采取更为审慎的捕捞，而对另一些种群采取更为积极的捕捞。尽管预计气候变化将使55%的亚洲渔业的环境容纳量下降，但本文发现，在气候变化情景下，渔业管理改革仍能带来可观的收益，只是这些收益存在异质性。无论是就渔获量还是利润而言，改革的理由依然充分，尽管这些数字略低于无气候变化的情形。这些结果表明，为了最大化经济产出和粮食安全，尽管气候变化的影响迫在眉睫，亚洲渔业仍将从向渔获份额制（catch shares）或其他经济理性的渔业管理制度转型中获得显著收益。

title: Improved fisheries management could offset many negative effects of climate change
abstract: The world's oceans supply food and livelihood to billions of people, yet species' shifting geographic ranges and changes in productivity arising from climate change are expected to profoundly affect these benefits. We ask how improvements in fishery management can offset the negative consequences of climate change; we find that the answer hinges on the current status of stocks. The poor current status of many stocks combined with potentially maladaptive responses to range shifts could reduce future global fisheries yields and profits even more severely than previous estimates have suggested. However, reforming fisheries in ways that jointly fix current inefficiencies, adapt to fisheries productivity changes, and proactively create effective transboundary institutions could lead to a future with higher profits and yields compared to what is produced today.
abstract_zh: 世界海洋为数十亿人提供食物和生计，然而，气候变化引起的物种地理分布范围变动和生产力变化预计将深刻影响这些福利。我们探讨渔业管理的改进如何能够抵消气候变化的负面后果；我们发现，答案取决于种群的当前状况。许多种群目前状况不佳，加之对分布范围变动可能产生的适应不良反应，可能使未来全球渔业产量和利润的减少比以往估计的更为严重。然而，如果以一种既能同时修正当前的低效率、又能适应渔业生产力变化，并主动建立有效跨界制度的方式进行渔业改革，那么未来的利润和产量就有可能高于今天的水平。

title: Marine spatial planning makes room for offshore aquaculture in crowded coastal waters
Maximizing the impact of climate finance: Funding projects or pilot projects?
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: This paper contributes to the understanding of how to maximize the impact of publicly provided climate finance to leverage the private sector. Agencies seeking to promote private investment in support of climate change mitigation and adaptation may have a choice between subsidizing projects or pilot projects. Pilots are either scaled down versions of full projects or an experimental phase that generates better information about whether a full project is likely to succeed or fail. Drawing on insights about the value of experimentation for entrepreneurship and raising private capital, the theoretical model developed herein provides guidance about when subsidizing projects or pilots is more efficient.
abstract_zh: 本文有助于理解如何最大化公共提供的气候融资以撬动私营部门的作用。旨在促进气候变化减缓和适应领域私人投资的机构，可能需要在资助项目与资助试点项目之间作出选择。试点要么是完整项目的缩小版，要么是一个能够生成更好信息的实验阶段，用以判断完整项目是否可能成功或失败。借鉴实验对于创业和融集私人资本的价值，本文构建的理论模型为何时资助项目或试点更为有效提供了指导。

title: Protecting marine mammals, turtles, and birds by rebuilding global fisheries
abstract: Reductions in global fishing pressure are needed to end overfishing of target species and maximize the value of fisheries. We ask whether such reductions would also be sufficient to protect non-target species threatened as bycatch. We compare changes in fishing pressure needed to maximize profits from 4713 target fish stocks-accounting for >75% of global catch-to changes in fishing pressure needed to reverse ongoing declines of 20 marine mammal, sea turtle, and seabird populations threatened as bycatch. We project that maximizing fishery profits would halt or reverse declines of approximately half of these threatened populations. Recovering the other populations would require substantially greater effort reductions or targeting improvements. Improving commercial fishery management could thus yield important collateral benefits for threatened bycatch species globally.
abstract_zh: 需要降低全球捕捞压力，以终止目标物种的过度捕捞，并使渔业价值最大化。我们探讨此类降低是否也足以保护那些作为兼捕物而受到威胁的非目标物种。我们比较了两方面的变化：一是使4713个目标鱼类种群（占全球渔获量的75%以上）利润最大化所需的捕捞压力变化，二是扭转20个作为兼捕物而受到威胁的海洋哺乳动物、海龟和海鸟种群持续下降趋势所需的捕捞压力变化。我们预测，使渔业利润最大化将可以阻止或扭转这些受威胁种群中约一半的下降趋势。要恢复其余种群，则需要大幅度更多的捕捞努力削减或更有针对性的改进。因此，改善商业渔业管理可能会为全球受威胁的兼捕物种带来重要的附带效益。

title: Rapid and lasting gains from solving illegal fishing
Spatial renewable resource extraction under possible regime shift
abstract: How will countries harvesting mobile natural resources react to the possibility of regime shift? We address the non‐cooperative exploitation of a migratory renewable resource in the presence of possible regime shift that affects its movement. Motivated by the anticipated effects of climate change, we model a regime shift that will alter the spatial movement patterns of the resource at some point in the future. We develop a stochastic spatial bioeconomic model to address the effects of this class of regime shift on non‐cooperative harvest decisions made by decentralized owners such as countries exploiting a migratory fish or other natural resource stock. We find that the threat of a future shift modifies the standard “golden rule”, and may induce more aggressive harvest everywhere, irrespective of whether the owner will be advantaged or disadvantaged by the shift. We also identify conditions under which the threat of regime shift induces owners to reduce harvest rates in advance of the shift. Our analysis suggests that different property rights structures (single ownership vs common property) or heterogeneous growth can give rise to previously unexplored incentives and can even reverse conventional wisdom about how countries will react to the prospect of future environmental change.
abstract_zh: 面对可能发生的体制转变，从事可迁移自然资源开采的国家会如何反应？我们研究了在一种可能影响资源迁移的体制转变存在的情况下，对可迁移可再生资源的非合作开采。受气候变化预期影响的启发，我们建模了一种体制转变，它将在未来某个时点改变资源的空间迁移模式。我们构建了一个随机空间生物经济模型，用以分析此类体制转变对去中心化所有者（如开采洄游鱼类或其他自然资源存量的国家）非合作捕捞决策的影响。我们发现，对未来转变的威胁会修正标准的“黄金法则”，并可能促使各处都采取更为激进的捕捞，无论所有者是否会因该转变而获益或受损。我们还识别出在某些条件下，对体制转变的威胁会促使所有者在转变发生之前降低捕捞率。我们的分析表明，不同的产权结构（单一所有或公共产权）或异质的增长状况，可能产生以往未被探讨的激励，甚至可能颠覆关于各国如何应对未来环境变化的传统认识。

title: The cost of management delay: The case for reforming Mexican fisheries sooner rather than later
The economics of fishing the high seas
Tracking the global footprint of fisheries
abstract: Although fishing is one of the most widespread activities by which humans harvest natural resources, its global footprint is poorly understood and has never been directly quantified. We processed 22 billion automatic identification system messages and tracked >70,000 industrial fishing vessels from 2012 to 2016, creating a global dynamic footprint of fishing effort with spatial and temporal resolution two to three orders of magnitude higher than for previous data sets. Our data show that industrial fishing occurs in >55% of ocean area and has a spatial extent more than four times that of agriculture. We find that global patterns of fishing have surprisingly low sensitivity to short-term economic and environmental variation and a strong response to cultural and political events such as holidays and closures.
abstract_zh: 尽管捕鱼是人类获取自然资源最普遍的活动之一，但其全球足迹一直鲜为人知，也从未被直接量化。我们处理了220亿条自动识别系统信息，追踪了2012年至2016年间超过70,000艘工业捕鱼船，由此构建了一个全球动态捕捞努力足迹，其空间和时间分辨率比以往数据集高出两到三个数量级。我们的数据表明，工业捕鱼发生在超过55%的海洋面积中，其空间范围是农业的四倍多。我们发现，全球捕鱼格局对短期经济和环境变化的敏感性出乎意料地低，而对节假日和禁渔期等文化与政治事件则反应强烈。

title: A decision support tool for designing turf-reserves
Describing ecosystem contexts with single-species models: a theoretical synthesis for fisheries
High fishery catches through trophic cascades in China
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: Fishing marine ecosystems indiscriminately and intensely can have negative impacts on biodiversity, but it may increase the biomass of fish available for capture in the system. We explore the possibility that China’s high fishery catches are a result of predator removal using an ecosystem model of the East China Sea (ECS). We show that China’s high fishery catches can be explained by the removal of larger predatory fish and consequent increases in the production of smaller fish. We project that single-species management would decrease catches in the ECS by reversing these ecosystem effects. Fisheries similar to those in China produce a large fraction of global catch; management reform in these areas must consider the entire ecosystem, rather than individual species.
abstract_zh: 毫无节制且高强度地捕捞海洋生态系统，可能对生物多样性产生负面影响，但也可能增加该系统中可供捕获的鱼类生物量。我们利用东海生态系统模型，探讨中国高渔获量是否源于顶级捕食者的移除。我们表明，中国高渔获量可以通过移除大型肉食性鱼类，进而使小型鱼类的产量增加来加以解释。我们预测，单一物种管理将通过逆转这些生态系统效应而使东海渔获量下降。与中国情况类似的渔业生产了全球渔获量的很大一部分；因此，这些地区的管理改革必须考虑整个生态系统，而不仅仅是单个物种。

title: Marine reserves solve an important bycatch problem in fisheries
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: Bycatch, where one species is unintentionally caught in pursuit of another species, is one of the most ubiquitous and crippling challenges in global fisheries. The usual solution is to dramatically reduce take of the target species to allow “weak stock” persistence. Using a general strategic model, we show that establishing areas closed to fishing can alleviate, or even completely eliminate, this problem. If the weak stock is long-lived, but slow to reproduce, significantly higher yields can be obtained by using reserves than by using fishing effort controls alone. We emphasize that this is the problem plaguing the US West Coast groundfish fishery, suggesting that in that fishery, marine reserves may be a solution that simultaneously benefits fishermen and conservation.
abstract_zh: 兼捕是指一种物种在捕捞另一种物种时被无意捕获，它是全球渔业中最普遍、也最具破坏性的挑战之一。通常的解决办法是大幅减少对目标物种的捕捞，以使“弱势种群”得以维持。我们利用一个一般化的战略模型表明，设立禁渔区可以缓解甚至彻底消除这一问题。若弱势种群寿命较长但繁殖缓慢，那么与仅采用捕捞努力控制相比，利用保护区可以获得显著更高的产量。我们强调，这正是困扰美国西海岸底层鱼类渔业的问题，这表明在该渔业中，海洋保护区可能是一种能够同时使渔民和保护目标均受益的解决方案。

title: Natural resource federalism: Preferences versus connectivity for patchy resources
Opportunities and precautions for integrating cooperation and individual transferable quotas with territorial use rights in fisheries
abstract: Territorial use rights in fisheries (TURFs), which allocate spatial fishing rights to fishers, are increasingly implemented in an effort to incentivize sustainable fishing practices. In some contexts, TURFs may be preferred over other rights-based approaches, such as individual transferable quotas (ITQs). However, TURFs may not always achieve fishery goals, for example, when competition exists within or among TURFs. Under these circumstances, there may be value in combining TURFs with cooperatives and/or ITQs to achieve benefits that may not be possible using only one management instrument alone. We use a bioeconomic model to explore potential outcomes of combining TURFs with cooperatives and ITQs, and identify conditions under which combining these approaches can help achieve fishery goals. Our results indicate that ITQs among TURFs can result in optimal levels of profit, even in conditions involving source-sink movement dynamics and heterogeneous fishing skill. We also show that institutions that facilitate cooperation within TURFs can provide near-optimal levels of profits, though this ability depends on cooperation being present in all TURFs within the system. Decreasing costs through ITQs or cooperatives can provide an incentive to catch more fish and drive down biomass, though the TURF structure itself prevents overfishing in our modeled system.
abstract_zh: 渔业领海使用权（TURFs）将空间捕捞权分配给渔民，目前正日益被推行，以激励可持续的捕鱼做法。在某些情境下，TURFs可能比个体可转让配额（ITQs）等其他权利基础方法更受青睐。然而，当TURFs内部或之间存在竞争时，TURFs可能无法总是实现渔业目标。在这些情况下，将TURFs与合作社和/或ITQs相结合，可能具有价值，从而获得仅使用单一管理工具时无法实现的收益。我们运用生物经济模型探讨了TURFs与合作社和ITQs相结合的潜在结果，并识别了这些方法组合能够帮助实现渔业目标的条件。我们的结果表明，即使在存在源—汇迁移动态和捕捞技能异质性的情况下，TURFs之间的ITQs也能带来最优水平的利润。我们还表明，促进TURFs内部合作的制度可以提供接近最优的利润水平，但这一能力取决于系统内所有TURFs中均存在合作。通过ITQs或合作社降低成本，可能会激励人们多捕鱼并使生物量下降，不过在我们所模拟的系统中，TURF结构本身可以防止过度捕捞。

title: Private eradication of mobile public bads
Range contraction enables harvesting to extinction
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences

title: The potential for blue growth in marine fish yield, profit and abundance of fish in the ocean
To what extent can ecosystem services motivate protecting biodiversity?
abstract: Society increasingly focuses on managing nature for the services it provides people rather than for the existence of particular species. How much biodiversity protection would result from this modified focus? Although biodiversity contributes to ecosystem services, the details of which species are critical, and whether they will go functionally extinct in the future, are fraught with uncertainty. Explicitly considering this uncertainty, we develop an analytical framework to determine how much biodiversity protection would arise solely from optimising net value from an ecosystem service. Using stochastic dynamic programming, we find that protecting a threshold number of species is optimal, and uncertainty surrounding how biodiversity produces services makes it optimal to protect more species than are presumed critical. We define conditions under which the economically optimal protection strategy is to protect all species, no species, and cases in between. We show how the optimal number of species to protect depends upon different relationships between species and services, including considering multiple services. Our analysis provides simple criteria to evaluate when managing for particular ecosystem services could warrant protecting all species, given uncertainty. Evaluating this criterion with empirical estimates from different ecosystems suggests that optimising some services will be more likely to protect most species than others.
abstract_zh: 社会日益关注为人类提供服务而管理自然，而不是为了特定物种的存续而管理。这种关注方式的调整能带来多大的生物多样性保护效果？尽管生物多样性对生态系统服务有所贡献，但哪些物种是关键的，以及它们在未来是否会在功能上灭绝，都存在很大的不确定性。考虑到这种不确定性，我们构建了一个分析框架，以确定仅通过优化生态系统服务的净价值可以产生多大程度的生物多样性保护。运用随机动态规划，我们发现，保护一定阈值数量的物种是最优的，而物种如何产生服务的不确定性使得保护比预设为关键的物种更多的物种成为最优选择。我们定义了经济上最优的保护策略为保护所有物种、不保护任何物种以及介于两者之间情形的条件。我们还展示了最优保护物种数量如何取决于物种与服务之间的不同关系，包括考虑多种服务的情形。我们的分析提供了简单的标准，用以评估在存在不确定性的情况下，针对特定生态系统服务进行管理何时可能需要保护所有物种。利用来自不同生态系统的经验估计对该标准进行评估后表明，优化某些服务比优化其他服务更有可能保护大多数物种。

title: A model to assess trade-offs between environmental impact and profitability of offshore salmon farms: A case study on Chile
abstract: In recent decades, aquaculture has emerged as a viable method to help supply the growing global demand for seafood; however, expansion of the industry comes with potential negative impacts. Regulatory decisions governing aspects like aquaculture farming practices and farm siting inherently lead to trade-offs between profitability and the health of the surrounding environment through impacts including pollution, disease, and disturbance from escaped fish. Efficiently and sustainably scaling up aquaculture will require the development of methods for explicitly examining the trade-offs among these impacts and socioeconomic objectives. We developed a model to assess these trade-offs and illustrate the approach with a case study of salmon aquaculture in southern Chile. In the case study we found evidence that all 21 farms with approved permits may be underperforming on both profitability and the protection of ecosystem health. Our model suggests that explicit evaluation of trade-offs can illuminate the potential for improvements on multiple outcomes simultaneously.
abstract_zh: 近几十年来，水产养殖已成为满足全球日益增长的海产品需求的一种可行方式；然而，该行业的扩张也带来了潜在的负面影响。影响水产养殖养殖方式和养殖场选址的监管决策，本身就会导致盈利能力与周边环境健康之间的权衡，这些影响包括污染、疾病以及逃逸鱼类造成的干扰。若要高效且可持续地扩大水产养殖规模，就需要发展能够明确考察这些影响与社会经济目标之间权衡的方法。我们构建了一个模型来评估这些权衡，并以智利南部的鲑鱼养殖为案例进行说明。在该案例研究中，我们发现有证据表明，所有获得批准许可的21个养殖场在盈利能力和生态系统健康保护两方面可能均表现不佳。我们的模型表明，对权衡的明确评估可以揭示同时在多个结果上取得改进的潜力。

title: Designing and financing optimal enforcement for small-scale fisheries and dive tourism industries
Distributional effects of the transition to property rights for a common-pool resource
Fish banks: An economic model to scale marine conservation
abstract: Only 2.1% of the ocean is in actively managed marine protected areas (MPAs). Achieving the United Nations' target of 10% of the ocean protected by 2020 will require an aggressively implemented mix of large MPAs in remote areas, and small MPAs in inhabited coastal areas. Replication of small no-take MPAs (marine reserves) in coastal areas at the global scale is more likely to occur if reserves are designed as investment opportunities – ‘fish banks’ that produce new profits based on ecosystem services such as tourism and fish production. Here a pro forma business plan for a marine reserve using private investment and local management is presented. Total annual profit before the reserve was €254,000 (from fishing only); in year 8 after creation of the reserve, profit (fishing+tourism) was €3.3 million. Given the right conditions, the net present value of the reserve can be between 4 and 12 times greater than the no-reserve counterfactual. In our model, (1) the tourism sector covers the costs of creation and operation of the reserve as an investment in a profitable business; and (2) fishers become shareholders and receive income from tourist access fees; their profits increase as soon as one year after the creation of the reserve. A series of financing mechanisms to create and manage fish banks is also proposed. If designed properly, fish banks can help restore marine biodiversity and ecosystem services, and can create jobs, help fishers, and bring in significantly greater economic profits than the absence of protection.
abstract_zh: 全球仅有2.1%的海洋处于积极管理的海洋保护区（MPAs）之中。要实现联合国到2020年保护10%海洋的目标，需要在偏远地区积极推行大型保护区，并在有人居住的沿海地区推行小型保护区，两者相结合。若将小型禁渔保护区（海洋保护区）设计为投资机会，即“鱼库”（fish banks），即基于旅游和渔业生产等生态系统服务产生新利润的项目，则这类沿海小型禁渔区在全球范围内更有可能被复制推广。在此，我们提出了一份利用私人投资和地方管理设立海洋保护区的预测性商业计划书。在设立保护区之前，每年的总利润（仅来自捕鱼）为254,000欧元；保护区设立后的第8年，利润（捕鱼加旅游）达到330万欧元。在适当的条件下，保护区的净现值可以是反事实无保护区情形的4至12倍。在我们的模型中，（1）旅游业足以覆盖保护区设立与运营的成本，使其成为一项有利可图的商业投资；（2）渔民成为股东，并从游客准入费中获得收入；其利润在保护区设立后最快一年即可增加。文章还提出了一系列用于设立和管理鱼库的融资机制。若设计得当，鱼库可以帮助恢复海洋生物多样性和生态系统服务，创造就业机会，帮助渔民，并带来显著高于无保护情形的经济利润。

title: Five rules for pragmatic blue growth
Global fishery prospects under contrasting management regimes
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: What would extensive fishery reform look like? In addition, what would be the benefits and trade-offs of implementing alternative approaches to fisheries management on a worldwide scale? To find out, we assembled the largest-of-its-kind database and coupled it to state-of-the-art bioeconomic models for more than 4,500 fisheries around the world. We find that, in nearly every country of the world, fishery recovery would simultaneously drive increases in food provision, fishery profits, and fish biomass in the sea. Our results suggest that a suite of approaches providing individual or communal access rights to fishery resources can align incentives across profit, food, and conservation so that few trade-offs will have to be made across these objectives in selecting effective policy interventions.
abstract_zh: 广泛的渔业改革将是什么样子？此外，在全球范围内实施替代性渔业管理方法的收益和权衡取舍又是怎样的？为此，我们汇集了同类中规模最大的数据库，并将其与最先进的生物经济模型相结合，涵盖全球4500多个渔业。我们发现，在世界几乎每一个国家，渔业恢复都将同时带来粮食供应增加、渔业利润提高以及海洋鱼类生物量增长。我们的结果表明，一套向个人或社区提供渔业资源准入权的方法，能够使利润、粮食和保护的激励相互一致，从而在选择有效政策干预时，这些目标之间几乎无需进行取舍。

title: Pollution control under a possible future shift in environmental preferences
Private conservation in TURF-managed fisheries
Unexpected management choices when accounting for uncertainty in ecosystem service tradeoff analyses
abstract: Resource management and conservation increasingly focus on ecosystem service provisioning and potential tradeoffs among services under different management actions. Application of bioeconomic approaches to tradeoffs assessment is touted as a way to find win‐win outcomes or avoid unnecessary stakeholder conflict. Yet, nearly all assessments to date have ignored inherent uncertainties in the provision and valuation of services. We incorporate uncertainty into the ecosystem services analytical framework and show how such inclusion improves optimal decision making. In particular, we show: (1) “suboptimal” solutions can become optimal when uncertainties are accounted for; (2) uncertainty paradoxically makes stakeholders value conservation despite their lack of preference for it; and (3) substantial losses or missed gains in ecosystem service provisioning can be incurred when uncertainty is ignored. Our results highlight the urgency of accounting for uncertainties in ecosystem services in tradeoff assessments given the widespread use of this approach by government agencies and conservation organizations.
abstract_zh: 资源管理和保护日益侧重于生态系统服务的供给，以及不同管理行动下各项服务之间可能存在的权衡。将生物经济方法应用于权衡评估，被推崇为寻找双赢结果或避免不必要利益相关者冲突的一种途径。然而，迄今几乎所有评估都忽视了服务供给和估值中固有的不确定性。我们将不确定性纳入生态系统服务分析框架，并表明这种纳入如何改善最优决策。具体而言，我们表明：（1）当考虑不确定性时，“次优”解可能变为最优解；（2）不确定性使利益相关者在缺乏保护偏好的情况下反而重视保护；（3）若忽视不确定性，生态系统服务供给可能遭受大量损失或错失收益。鉴于政府机构和保护组织广泛使用这一方法，我们的结果凸显了在权衡评估中考虑生态系统服务不确定性的紧迫性。

title: Partial enclosure of the commons
Solutions for recovering and sustaining the bounty of the ocean combining fishery reforms, rights-based fisheries management, and marine reserves
abstract: Food security, economic opportunities, and other benefits provided by a healthy ocean are in jeopardy because of years of overexploitation of many fisheries, and the challenges will intensify in many locales as climate and the environment continue to change. The good news is that solutions are gaining traction. Mandates to end overfishing that use scientifically determined catch limits and rights-based approaches to fishery management have produced impressive results in ending overfishing and recovering depleted stocks. Similarly, spatial protections, such as fully protected marine reserves, are increasing the diversity, size, and abundance of species within reserves; some of that bounty reaches fished areas outside of them. We review the effects of combining catch limits, rights-based fisheries approaches, and establishment of marine reserves and discuss additional advantages of these combined solutions in securing sustainable and profitable fisheries, community goals, and healthy ecosystems. This paper highlights the contribution of emerging science-based solutions and the steps needed to replicate and scale these successes. Triple-wins for the environment, the economy, and society can be achieved through integrated fisheries management and protection as conscious steps toward reversing the current degradation of our ocean’s living resources.
abstract_zh: 健康的海洋所提供的粮食安全、经济机会和其他福利，正因多年来对许多渔业的过度开发而面临危险，而且随着气候和环境的持续变化，许多地方面临的挑战还将加剧。好消息是，解决方案正日益获得支持。采用科学确定的捕捞限额和权利基础渔业管理方法来制止过度捕捞，已在结束过度捕捞和恢复枯竭种群方面取得了令人瞩目的成果。同样，诸如完全保护的海洋保护区等空间保护措施，正在增加保护区内物种的多样性、体型和丰度，其中部分渔获资源会溢出到保护区之外的捕捞区域。我们回顾了将捕捞限额、权利基础渔业方法与海洋保护区设立相结合的效果，并讨论了这些综合解决方案在确保渔业可持续性和盈利性、实现社区目标以及维护健康生态系统方面的额外优势。本文强调了新兴的科学解决方案的贡献，以及复制和推广这些成功经验所需采取的步骤。通过综合性的渔业管理和保护，环境、经济和社会三方共赢是可以实现的，这也是扭转当前海洋生物资源退化局面的切实步骤。

title: Close the high seas to fishing?
Conservation markets for wildlife management with case studies from whaling
abstract: Although market‐based incentives have helped resolve many environmental challenges, conservation markets still play a relatively minor role in wildlife management. Establishing property rights for environmental goods and allowing trade between resource extractors and resource conservationists may offer a path forward in conserving charismatic species like whales, wolves, turtles, and sharks. In this paper, we provide a conceptual model for implementing a conservation market for wildlife and evaluate how such a market could be applied to three case studies for whales (minke [Balaenoptera acutorostrata], bowhead [Balaena mysticetus], and gray [Eschrictius robustus]). We show that, if designed and operated properly, such a market could ensure persistence of imperiled populations, while simultaneously improving the welfare of resource harvesters.
abstract_zh: 尽管基于市场的激励措施已帮助解决了许多环境挑战，但保护市场在野生动物管理中仍然发挥着相对次要的作用。为环境产品确立产权，并允许资源开采者与资源保护者之间进行交易，可能为保护鲸鱼、狼、海龟和鲨鱼等具有标志性的物种指明一条道路。本文提出了一个实施野生动物保护市场的概念模型，并评估了此类市场如何应用于三个鲸类案例研究（小须鲸［Balaenoptera acutorostrata］、弓头鲸［Balaena mysticetus］和灰鲸［Eschrictius robustus］）。我们表明，如果设计和运行得当，这样的市场既可以确保濒危种群的存续，同时又能改善资源捕捞者的福利。

title: Eco-label conveys reliable information on fish stock health to seafood consumers
Marine protected areas and the value of spatially optimized fishery management
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: There is a growing focus around the world on marine spatial planning, including spatial fisheries management. Some spatial management approaches are quite blunt, as when marine protected areas (MPAs) are established to restrict fishing in specific locations. Other management tools, such as zoning or spatial user rights, will affect the distribution of fishing effort in a more nuanced manner. Considerable research has focused on the ability of MPAs to increase fishery returns, but the potential for the broader class of spatial management approaches to outperform MPAs has received far less attention. We use bioeconomic models of seven nearshore fisheries in Southern California to explore the value of optimized spatial management in which the distribution of fishing is chosen to maximize profits. We show that fully optimized spatial management can substantially increase fishery profits relative to optimal nonspatial management but that the magnitude of this increase depends on characteristics of the fishing fleet and target species. Strategically placed MPAs can also increase profits substantially compared with nonspatial management, particularly if fishing costs are low, although profit increases available through optimal MPA-based management are roughly half those from fully optimized spatial management. However, if the same total area is protected by randomly placing MPAs, starkly contrasting results emerge: most random MPA designs reduce expected profits. The high value of spatial management estimated here supports continued interest in spatially explicit fisheries regulations but emphasizes that predicted increases in profits can only be achieved if the fishery is well understood and the regulations are strategically designed.
abstract_zh: 全世界越来越关注海洋空间规划，包括空间渔业管理。一些空间管理方法相对粗放，例如设立海洋保护区（MPAs）以限制特定地点的捕捞。其他管理工具，例如分区或空间用益权，则会以更为细致的方式影响捕捞努力的分布。大量研究关注了海洋保护区提高渔业收益的能力，但更广泛的空间管理方法超越海洋保护区的潜力却很少受到关注。我们运用南加州七个近岸渔业的生物经济模型，探讨以利润最大化为目标选择捕捞分布的优化空间管理的价值。我们表明，完全优化的空间管理相对于最优的非空间管理可以显著提高渔业利润，但这一增幅的大小取决于渔船的特征和目标物种的特点。相较于非空间管理，战略性布局的海洋保护区同样可以显著提高利润，特别是在捕鱼成本较低的情况下，但通过最优的基于保护区的管理所能获得的利润增幅，大约只有完全优化的空间管理的一半。然而，如果以随机布局的方式保护相同的总面积，则会出现截然不同的结果：大多数随机设计的海洋保护区都会降低预期利润。本文估计的空间管理高价值，支持了人们对空间明确的渔业规制的持续关注，但也强调，只有在充分了解渔业并进行战略性规制设计的前提下，利润的预期增长才能实现。

title: Status and solutions for the world's unassessed fisheries
abstract:
While salmon, cod, and tuna fisheries are regularly monitored and assessed, this is not the case for about 80% of the fish species harvested throughout the world.
Costello
et al.
(p.
517
published online 27 September; see the Perspective by
Pikitch
) used a model that integrates harvest, population, and ecological data to estimate the status of unassessed fisheries, based on ecologically analogous, regularly assessed fisheries. Generally, unassessed fisheries are in worse condition with declining fish stocks compared with regularly assessed fisheries.
abstract_zh: 虽然鲑鱼、鳕鱼和金枪鱼渔业受到定期监测和评估，但全球约80%被捕捞的鱼类物种并非如此。Costello等人（第517页，9月27日在线发表；另见Pikitch的观点文章）使用了一个整合了捕捞、种群和生态数据的模型，基于生态上类似、经过定期评估的渔业，估计了未评估渔业的状况。总体而言，与定期评估的渔业相比，未评估的渔业状况更差，鱼类种群呈下降趋势。

title: The value of coordinated management of interacting ecosystem services
abstract:
Ecology Letters
(2012)
Coordinating decisions and actions among interacting sectors is a critical component of ecosystem‐based management, but uncertainty about coordinated management’s effects is compromising its perceived value and use. We constructed an analytical framework for explicitly calculating how coordination affects management decisions, ecosystem state and the provision of ecosystem services in relation to ecosystem dynamics and socio‐economic objectives. The central insight is that the appropriate comparison strategy to optimal coordinated management is optimal uncoordinated management, which can be identified at the game theoretic Nash equilibrium. Using this insight we can calculate coordination’s effects in relation to uncoordinated management and other reference scenarios. To illustrate how this framework can help identify ecosystem and socio‐economic conditions under which coordination is most influential and valuable, we applied it to a heuristic case study and a simulation model for the California Current Marine Ecosystem. Results indicate that coordinated management can more than double an ecosystem’s societal value, especially when sectors can effectively manipulate resources that interact strongly. However, societal gains from coordination will need to be reconciled with observations that it also leads to strategic simplification of the ecological food web, and generates both positive and negative impacts on individual sectors and non‐target species.
abstract_zh:
《生态学快报》（2012）
协调相互作用部门之间的决策与行动，是基于生态系统的管理的关键组成部分，但关于协调管理效果的不确定性，正在削弱其被认可的价值和应用。我们构建了一个分析框架，用以明确计算协调如何影响管理决策、生态系统状态以及生态系统服务的供给，并将其与生态系统动态和社会经济目标相联系。其核心见解在于，协调最优管理的恰当比较对象是非协调的最优管理，后者可以通过博弈论中的纳什均衡加以识别。利用这一见解，我们可以计算协调相对于非协调管理及其他参照情景的效果。为说明该框架如何帮助识别协调最具影响力和价值的生态与社会经济条件，我们将其应用于一个启发式案例研究，以及加州海流海洋生态系统的模拟模型。结果表明，协调管理可以使生态系统的社会价值增加一倍以上，特别是当各部门能够有效操纵相互作用强烈的资源时。然而，协调所带来的社会收益，还需与其导致生态食物网战略性简化，以及对个别部门和非目标物种产生正负两方面影响的情况相权衡。

title: Matching spatial property rights fisheries with scales of fish dispersal
abstract: Regulation of fisheries using spatial property rights can alleviate competition for high-value patches that hinders economic efficiency in quota-based, rights-based, and open-access management programs. However, efficiency gains erode when delineation of spatial rights constitutes incomplete ownership of the resource, thereby degrading its local value and promoting overexploitation. Incomplete ownership may be particularly prevalent in the spatial management of mobile fishery species. We developed a game-theoretic bioeconomic model of spatial property rights representing territorial user rights fisheries (TURF) management of nearshore marine fish and invertebrate species with mobile adult and larval life history stages. Strategic responses by fisheries in neighboring management units result in overexploitation of the stock and reduced yields for each fishery compared with those attainable without resource mobility or with coordination or sole control in fishing effort. High dispersal potential of the larval stage, a common trait among nearshore fishery species, coupled with scaling of management units to only capture adult mobility, a common characteristic of many nearshore TURF programs, in particular substantially reduced stock levels and yields. In a case study of hypothetical TURF programs of nearshore fish and invertebrate species, management units needed to be tens of kilometers in alongshore length to minimize larval export and generate reasonable returns to fisheries. Cooperation and quota regulations represent solutions to the problem that need to be quantified in cost and integrated into the determination of the acceptability of spatial property rights management of fisheries.
abstract_zh: 利用空间产权来规制渔业，可以缓解高价值渔场上的竞争，而这种竞争在配额制、权利基础制和开放准入的管理计划中都会阻碍经济效率。然而，当空间权利的划定构成对资源的不完全所有权时，效率收益会逐渐消失，因为这会降低资源的本地价值，并助长过度开发。这种不完全所有权在可迁移渔业物种的空间管理中可能尤为普遍。我们构建了一个博弈论生物经济模型，用以刻画近岸海洋鱼类和无脊椎动物（具有可迁移的成鱼和幼体生活史阶段）的领海使用权渔业（TURF）管理中的空间产权。相邻管理单元中渔业的战略性反应，导致了种群的过度开发，与不存在资源迁移或在捕捞努力方面实行协调或单一控制时可获得的结果相比，每个渔业的产量都有所减少。幼体阶段较高的扩散潜力（这是近岸渔业物种的普遍特征），加上管理单元的规模仅能捕获成鱼迁移（这是许多近岸TURF项目的常见特征），尤其大幅降低了种群存量和产量。在对近岸鱼类和无脊椎动物假想TURF项目的案例研究中，管理单元沿岸长度需要达到数十公里，才能使幼体外流最小化并产生合理的渔业回报。合作与配额规制是解决该问题的办法，但需要对其成本进行量化，并将其纳入对渔业空间产权管理可接受性的判断之中。

title: The impact of climate change on California timberlands
Unitization of spatially connected renewable resources
venue: The B.E. Journal of Economic Analysis & Policy
abstract: Spatial connectivity of renewable resources induces a spatial externality in extraction. We explore the consequences of decentralized spatial property rights in the presence of spatial externalities. We generalize the notion of unitization -developed to enhance cooperative extraction of oil and gas fields -and apply it to renewable resources which face a similar spatial commons problem. We find that unitizing a common pool renewable resource can yield first-best outcomes even when participation is voluntary, provided profit sharing rules can vary by participant.
abstract_zh: 可再生资源的空间连通性会在开采中引发空间外部性。我们探讨了在存在空间外部性的情况下，去中心化空间产权的后果。我们推广了为提高石油和天然气田合作开采效率而发展起来的“统一开发”（unitization）概念，并将其应用于面临类似空间公地问题的可再生资源。我们发现，即使参与是自愿的，只要利润分配规则可以因参与者而异，统一开发共同池可再生资源就能够实现第一最优结果。

title: Using portfolio theory to assess tradeoffs between return from natural capital and social equity across space
Bounded uncertainty and climate change economics
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: It has been argued recently that the combination of risk aversion and an uncertainty distribution of future temperature change with a heavy upper tail invalidates mainstream economic analyses of climate change policy. A simple model is used to explore the effect of imposing an upper bound on future temperature change. The analysis shows that imposing even a high bound reverses the earlier argument and that the optimal policy, as measured by the willingness to pay to avoid climate change, is relatively insensitive to this bound over a wide range.
abstract_zh: 近来有观点认为，风险厌恶与未来气温变化不确定性分布的厚上尾相结合，会使主流的气候变化政策经济分析失效。本文利用一个简单模型，探讨对未来气温变化施加上界的影响。分析表明，即使施加一个较高的上界，也能扭转先前的论证，而且在较宽的范围内，以避免气候变化的支付意愿衡量的最优政策对该上界相对不敏感。

title: Economic incentives and global fisheries sustainability
abstract: Widespread global collapses of fisheries corroborate decades-old predictions by economists, made long before large-scale industrialization of the world's fisheries, that open access would have deleterious ecological and economic effects on fishery resources. Incentive-based alternatives (collectively called catch shares) have been shown to generate pecuniary benefits, but little empirical evidence exists for, or against, a link to global fisheries sustainability. We report and expand on an analysis of >11,000 fisheries worldwide, in which we investigated the causes of fisheries collapse from 1950 to 2003. Using a program evaluation design, we found that catch shares prevent and, in some specifications, reverse fisheries collapse. Subsequent scientific studies reinforce and challenge these findings, suggesting fruitful avenues for future research linking incentive-based resource management to sustainability.
abstract_zh: 全球渔业的广泛崩溃印证了经济学家数十年前的预测。早在世界渔业大规模工业化之前，经济学家就已指出，开放准入将对渔业资源产生有害的生态和经济后果。基于激励的替代方案（统称为渔获份额制）已被证明能够带来经济收益，但关于其与全球渔业可持续性之间是否存在联系，几乎没有支持或反对的实证证据。我们报告并拓展了对全球超过11,000个渔业的分析，考察了1950至2003年间渔业崩溃的成因。采用项目评估设计，我们发现渔获份额制能够预防渔业崩溃，并且在某些设定下甚至可以扭转渔业崩溃。随后的科学研究既强化也挑战了这些发现，为未来研究基于激励的资源管理与可持续性之间的联系指明了富有成效的方向。

title: Rebuilding global fisheries
abstract: Many fisheries that have been historically overexploited are now considered to be rebuilding, with a hope that current best practices could ensure the recovery of most overfished species by mid century. Our analysis suggests this optimism may be premature, as current projections typically assume managers can have perfect measurements of current stock sizes. We demonstrate how such an assumption can undermine rebuilding efforts under current best practices and even drive unintentional stock declines. By borrowing novel decision methods from the field of robotics, we also show how stock rebuilding can be achieved in the face of measurement and environmental uncertainty, while also achieving higher economic returns than expected under current approaches.
abstract_zh: 许多历史上被过度捕捞的渔业目前被认为正在恢复，人们希望现行最佳实践能够保证大多数过度捕捞物种在本世纪中叶前实现种群恢复。我们的分析表明，这种乐观可能为时过早，因为目前的预测通常假设管理者能够完美测量当前的种群规模。我们证明，这一假设可能削弱现行最佳实践下的种群恢复努力，甚至导致意外的种群下降。通过借鉴机器人学领域的新型决策方法，我们还展示了在存在测量误差和环境不确定性的情况下，如何实现种群恢复，同时获得高于现行方法预期的经济回报。

title: Can catch shares prevent fisheries collapse?
abstract: Recent reports suggest that most of the world's commercial fisheries could collapse within decades. Although poor fisheries governance is often implicated, evaluation of solutions remains rare. Bioeconomic theory and case studies suggest that rights-based catch shares can provide individual incentives for sustainable harvest that is less prone to collapse. To test whether catch-share fishery reforms achieve these hypothetical benefits, we have compiled a global database of fisheries institutions and catch statistics in 11,135 fisheries from 1950 to 2003. Implementation of catch shares halts, and even reverses, the global trend toward widespread collapse. Institutional change has the potential for greatly altering the future of global fisheries.
abstract_zh: 近期报告显示，全球大多数商业渔业可能在几十年内崩溃。尽管渔业治理不善常被认为是主要原因，但对解决方案的评估仍然罕见。生物经济学理论和案例研究表明，基于产权的渔获份额制能够为可持续捕捞提供个体激励，从而降低崩溃的可能性。为检验渔获份额制改革是否实现了这些假设中的收益，我们汇编了一个全球数据库，涵盖1950至2003年间11,135个渔业的渔业制度与渔获统计数据。渔获份额制的实施遏制了全球范围内普遍走向崩溃的趋势，甚至使之逆转。制度变革有可能极大地改变全球渔业的未来。

Marine reserve effects on fishery profit
abstract: Some studies suggest that fishery yields can be higher with reserves than under conventional management. However, the economic performance of fisheries depends on economic profit, not fish yield. The predictions of higher yields with reserves rely on intensive fishing pressures between reserves; the exorbitant costs of harvesting low‐density populations erode profits. We incorporated this effect into a bioeconomic model to evaluate the economic performance of reserve‐based management. Our results indicate that reserves can still benefit fisheries, even those targeting species that are expensive to harvest. However, in contrast to studies focused on yield, only a moderate proportion of the coast in reserves (with moderate harvest pressures outside reserves) is required to maximize profit. Furthermore, reserve area and harvest intensity can be traded off with little impact on profits, allowing for management flexibility while still providing higher profit than attainable under conventional management.
abstract_zh: 一些研究表明，与传统管理相比，设立保护区时渔业产量可能更高。然而，渔业的经济绩效取决于经济利润，而非鱼类产量。保护区能提高产量的预测依赖于保护区之间的高强度捕捞压力；而在低密度种群中捕捞的高昂成本会侵蚀利润。我们将这一效应纳入生物经济模型，以评估基于保护区的管理的经济绩效。结果表明，保护区仍能使渔业受益，即使是针对捕捞成本高昂的物种的渔业。然而，与关注产量的研究不同，要使利润最大化，只需将海岸的适度比例划为保护区（并保持保护区外的适度捕捞压力）。此外，保护区面积与捕捞强度之间可以相互权衡，对利润影响甚微，这使管理具有灵活性，同时仍能获得高于传统管理下可实现利润的收益。

title: Dynamic consequences of human behavior in the Serengeti ecosystem
abstract: This chapter develops a model of the interactions between local communities, wildlife, and management options in the Serengeti. The purpose is to provide a framework for analyzing management decision making and to evaluate different strategies for improving the lives of local people while preserving the park's wildlife. The chapter begins by describing the joint human-ecosystem model, including the model of household decision making, production and consumption, and how human population, livestock numbers, and wildlife populations evolve through time. It then explains the parameter values used in the model. Some results of several hypothetical scenarios are provided to illustrate the model's application.
abstract_zh: 本章构建了一个模型，用以刻画塞伦盖蒂地区当地社区、野生动物与管理选项之间的相互作用。其目的在于提供一个分析管理决策的框架，并评估改善当地居民生活同时保护公园野生动物的不同策略。本章首先描述人类—生态系统联合模型，包括家庭决策、生产与消费模型，以及人口、牲畜数量和野生动物种群如何随时间演化。随后说明模型中使用的参数取值。文中给出了若干假设情景的部分结果，以说明模型的应用。

title: Evaluating an invasive species policy: ballast water exchange in the Great Lakes
abstract: Improvements in environmental policy require an accurate diagnosis of the shortcomings of existing policy. We develop a model for assessing the efficacy of policy instruments aimed at reducing the introduction of nonindigenous species. The model identifies and accounts for several features of the nonindigenous species introduction-detection process that complicate interpretations of monitoring data. Specifically, the model includes explicit attention to the pathway of introduction, a probabilistic description of species detection, and the possibility of attenuation of species introductions over time. We apply this theoretical model to the case of mid-ocean ballast water exchange, which was implemented by the United States in 1990 for the North American Great Lakes. Contrary to other authors who take the recent increase in discoveries of nonindigeneous species (NIS) in the Great Lakes as evidence that ballast water exchange is ineffective, we find that the observed detection record could just as plausibly be explained by a lag of a few years between introduction and detection, even if ballast water exchange was 100% effective. Model results suggest that, under current monitoring regimes, several more years of data would be required to make a conclusive evaluation of ballast water exchange. Better estimation of the lag time between introduction and detection, and a shortening of that lag time with better monitoring, would allow more precise and timely evaluation of the efficacy of ballast water exchange and other policy instruments.
abstract_zh: 环境政策的改进需要准确诊断现行政策的不足之处。我们构建了一个模型，用于评估旨在减少外来物种引入的政策工具的有效性。该模型识别并考虑了外来物种引入—检测过程中的若干特征，这些特征使监测数据的解释变得复杂。具体而言，模型明确考虑了引入途径、物种检测的概率性描述，以及物种引入随时间衰减的可能性。我们将这一理论模型应用于远洋压载水置换政策的案例，该政策由美国于1990年为北美五大湖实施。与其他一些将五大湖近期外来物种（NIS）发现数量的增加视为压载水置换无效之证据的学者不同，我们发现，即使压载水置换完全有效，观测到的检测记录同样可以合理地由引入与检测之间相隔数年的滞后所解释。模型结果表明，在现行监测制度下，还需要再积累几年的数据，才能对压载水置换做出确定性评估。更准确地估计引入与检测之间的滞后时间，并通过改进监测缩短该滞后时间，将有助于更精确、更及时地评估压载水置换及其他政策工具的有效性。

title: The efficiency gains from fully delineating rights in an ITQ fishery
abstract: Individual transferable quota (ITQ) regulation relies on a decentralized market mechanism and a single price to allocate access to a stock of fish. The resulting allocation will not be fully efficient if the stock being allocated is heterogeneous or if there are potential gains from centralized coordination of harvesting effort. If stocks are heterogeneous in their density, location, or unit value during the season, harvesters governed by an ITQ policy will not be indifferent to when or where they exercise their quotas. Stocks that are relatively dense and/or close to port will be preferred to those less dense or more remote. Because an ITQ policy assigns the same opportunity cost for each unit harvested, individual harvesters have an incentive to compete for higher-valued units, and such competition may dissipate part of the fishery's potential rent. A similar phenomenon arises when stock densities vary in an unknown way over space or time, so harvesters must engage in costly search. Individual harvesters governed by an ITQ policy still face a collective action problem which limits the incentive to share information on stock locations. This can lead to redundant search effort. We demonstrate that both sources of inefficiency can be eliminated either by defining ITQ rights more precisely or by an agreement among harvesters to coordinate their effort. We develop models that illustrate these effects and identify the factors that determine their likely size. Anecdotal evidence on practices adopted by fishery cooperatives is presented to illustrate the practical relevance of the issues we raise.
abstract_zh: 个别可转让配额（ITQ）制度依赖于分散的市场机制和单一价格来分配对鱼类资源的捕捞准入。如果所分配的资源在密度、位置或季节内单位价值方面存在异质性，或者存在集中协调捕捞努力的潜在收益，那么由此产生的分配将不是完全有效的。如果资源在密度、位置或单位价值上存在异质性，受ITQ政策约束的捕捞者将不会对何时或在何处行使其配额无动于衷。资源密度较高和/或靠近港口的区域将比密度较低或较为偏远的区域更受青睐。由于ITQ政策对每单位捕捞量赋予相同的机会成本，个体捕捞者有激励去争夺价值更高的单位，而这种竞争可能耗散部分渔业潜在的租金。当资源密度以未知方式随空间或时间变化，从而捕捞者必须进行代价高昂的搜寻时，也会出现类似现象。受ITQ政策约束的个体捕捞者仍面临集体行动问题，这限制了他们分享资源位置信息的激励，并可能导致重复的搜寻努力。我们证明，通过更精确地界定ITQ权利，或通过捕捞者之间达成协议以协调努力，上述两类低效率均可被消除。我们构建了阐释这些效应的模型，并识别决定其可能规模的因素。文中还给出了渔业合作社所采取做法的案例性证据，以说明我们所提出问题的现实相关性。

title: Efficient conservation in a utility maximization framework
abstract: Systematic planning for biodiversity conservation is being conducted at scales ranging from global to national to regional. The prevailing planning paradigm is to identify the minimum land allocations needed to reach specified conservation targets or maximize the amount of conservation accomplished under an area or budget constraint. We propose a more general formulation for setting conservation priorities that involves goal setting, assessing the current conservation system, developing a scenario of future biodiversity given the current conservation system, and allocating available conservation funds to alter that scenario so as to maximize future biodiversity. Under this new formulation for setting conservation priorities, the value of a site depends on resource quality, threats to resource quality, and costs. This planning approach is designed to support collaborative processes and negotiation among competing interest groups. We demonstrate these ideas with a case study of the Sierra Nevada bioregion of California.
abstract_zh: 生物多样性保护的系统规划正在从全球、国家到区域等多个尺度上开展。目前占主导地位的规划范式是，在达到既定保护目标所需的最小土地配置，或在面积或预算约束下使保护成效最大化之间进行选择。我们提出了一种更为一般化的保护优先级设定框架，包括：设定目标、评估当前保护体系、在现行保护体系下构建未来生物多样性情景，以及分配可用的保护资金以改变该情景，从而使未来生物多样性最大化。在这一新框架下，一个地点的价值取决于资源质量、资源质量面临的威胁以及成本。该规划方法旨在支持相互竞争的利益群体之间的协作过程与协商。我们以加利福尼亚州内华达山脉生物区域的案例研究来说明这些思想。

title: Poverty and employment in forest dependent counties
abstract: One of the most controversial aspects of federal and state policies aimed at protecting old-growth ecosystems is the potential effect of job losses on local economic conditions. A fundamental question for historically forest-dependent areas is whether these policies will result in local economic stagnation and enduring pockets of poverty. This study uses monthly, multicounty time series data to estimate a vector autoregressive model of the experience of northern California counties during the 1980s and 1990s. It examines the long-run impact of changes in timber-related employment on other employment and participation in major federal poverty programs. It finds that employment base-multiplier effects of timber employment on other county employment are small and state economic conditions rather than local employment conditions are the principal driver behind local poverty.
abstract_zh: 联邦和州政府旨在保护老龄生态系统的政策中，最具争议的方面之一，是失业对地方经济状况可能产生的影响。对于历史上依赖森林的地区而言，一个根本性问题是：这些政策是否会导致地方经济停滞以及持久的贫困聚集区。本研究利用月度多县时间序列数据，估计了20世纪80年代和90年代北加利福尼亚各县经历的向量自回归模型。研究考察了与木材相关的就业变化对其他就业及参与主要联邦贫困计划的长期影响。研究发现，木材就业对其他县就业的乘数效应较小，而导致地方贫困的主要驱动因素是州经济状况，而非地方就业状况。
